options.systemMessage:
=You are given a JSON object containing LinkedIn conversation threads. Each thread includes messages, authors, and metadata. 
Your task is to:

1. Identify the prospects (anyone who is NOT "Contributor 01").
2. Check which prospects have replied in the conversation.
3. Create a short Slack message listing the prospects who replied and their responses.

Format the Slack message like this:

The following people have responded on LinkedIn:

- [Prospect Name] (<LinkedIn URL>): "[Most recent reply]"
- [Prospect Name] (<LinkedIn URL>): "[Most recent reply]"

If no prospects have replied, respond with:
"No prospects have replied yet."

$1
```")     // Links: [text](url) → <url|text>    .replace(/\[([^\]]+)\]\(([^)]+)\)/g, "<$2|$1>")     // Bullets: - item or * item → • item    .replace(/^- (.*)$/gm, "• $1")    .replace(/^\* (.*)$/gm, "• $1")     // Convert escaped
